senses.gloss:
m. (-लः)
A sort of grain, (Andropogon or Holcus sorghum.)
E.
यव barley, and नल culm or stalk, the व of the first word changed to उ, and उ with the inherent vowel of य changed to ओ.

mf. (-निः-निः or नी)
1 The vulva.
2 A mine.
3 Cause, origin.
4 Water.
5 Place or site of birth or production in general.
E.
यु to join or mix, Uṇādi aff. नि.

f. (-ता)
The 11th Nakṣatra or lunar asterism; also Pūrvaphalgunī.
E.
योनि the vulva, and दवता presiding deity.

f. (-सा)
The upper part of the vulva, or the union of the labiæ.
E.
योनि the womb, and नासा the nose.

n. (-नं)
The menstrual excretion.
E.
योनि pudendum, and रञ्जन colouring.

n. (-ङ्गं)
The clitoris.
E.
योनि the pudendum, and लिङ्ग the penis.

f. (-त्तिः)
Contraction or closure of the vagina.
E.
योनि, and संवृत्ति contraction.

m. (-रः)
Fault or blemish of birth on the mother's side, as from inferiority of caste, &c.
E.
योनि, and सङ्कर mixture.

n. (-र्शः)
An affection of the vulva, Menorrhagia, or prolapsus uteri.
E.
योनि the vulva, and अर्शस् piles.
